Seed Context: SA-0MTCSPA5H007IQ59 [test-failure] <suite exited 4>: pytest -q -r a --disable-warnings && node --test "tests/node/**/*.mjs" && node --test "tests/cli/**/*.mjs" && node --test "tests/unit/**/*.mjs" — type bug, priority critical, stage intake_complete, parent SA-0MSAFWEHT002RI72, failing commit a3b0d886, evidence: python -m pytest: error: unrecognized arguments: --test --test --test.

Diagnosis (2026-09-02): Each suite passes individually at HEAD (pytest 2827 passed at a3b0d886 / 2963 at dev; node 29 pass, cli 12 pass, unit 329 pass). Full-shell chain "pytest ... && node --test ... && node --test ... && node --test ..." also passes via bash. The recorded failure "<suite exited 4>: pytest ... && node --test ... && node --test ... && node --test ..." with stderr "unrecognized arguments: --test" indicates the entire &&-joined string was fed to pytest as arguments (e.g. via str.split() instead of shlex.split() or via passing the joined command to a single pytest invocation). Current codebase separates suites via full_suite_commands() and runs each through run_cached with shlex.split(executable_test_command(cmd)) in _cached_runner and executable_test_command — no reproduction at current HEAD. Root cause likely a transient triage/implement runner that joined commands before splitting; now fixed. If reassigned, implement should re-verify with run_tests.py --force and audit _run_tests_via_test_skill at HEAD; if green, close as stale/no-fix-needed with evidence.
